measuredFrom: Phase (21M) and Material (7.9M) at 30 fps; size/position also on Tag and Spirit Beasts stills

size.note: small on purpose: measured cap height 30-40 px (1.6-2.1% of frame height)

position.lines: 1 (2 only if the phrase is wider than 88%)

content.trailingEllipsis: use '..' on trailing phrases as the account does, optional

rules.when: the story's power word (the thing the hero can do)
rules.note: use the story's ONE power colour; cyan is the default

rules.when: danger, emotion or result words (deadly, ever, gone, stronger, never, cursed)

keyword.frequency: about 1 caption in 4 has a coloured word

timing.endsAt: next caption start (no gaps, no overlap)
timing.pictureCutRule: picture cut lands +1 f after the phrase's first word onset

in.note: long captions spill past the frame edges at f3; that is in the reference

hold.motion: none (no wobble, no per-word bounce, no shake)

out.note: swell over 3-5 f, then shrink in 2-3 f; next caption pops on the next frame

ass.keywordTag: {\c&HD0C427&}WORD{\c&HFFFFFF&}  (ASS colours are BGR: red #E0262A = &H2A26E0&, cyan #27C4D0 = &HD0C427&, yellow #F2D33A = &H3AD3F2&)
